add_numbers.description: This tool takes two numbers as input and returns their sum.

bad_add.description: This tool adds two numbers provided as input.

broken_add.description: This tool attempts to add two numbers. It contains a typo in the addition operation, likely intended to be 'x + y'.

broken_syntax_tool.description: This tool takes a string 'a' and repeats it 't' times, returning the resulting string.

crash_tool.description: This tool takes two string inputs, 'a' and 't', and returns 999999 if they are 'a' and 't' respectively. Otherwise, it returns None.

cube_number.description: This tool always returns -999 regardless of the input numbers, indicating a fundamental error or placeholder.

divide_numbers.description: This tool performs division of two numbers and handles division by zero errors.

factorial.description: This tool calculates the factorial of a non-negative integer.

fibonacci.description: This tool calculates the Fibonacci sequence up to a specified number of terms.

list_files.description: This tool lists all files within a specified directory.

migrate_error_handling.description: This tool modifies Python scripts within a specified directory to replace `return str(e)` with `raise Exception(str(e))` if present, likely for enhanced error handling.

multiply_numbers.description: This tool multiplies two numbers provided as strings.

multiply_square_root.description: This tool calculates the square root of a number and multiplies it by a given multiplier.

multiply_string.description: This tool multiplies a string by a number, repeating the string that many times.

read_webpage.description: This tool fetches the content of a webpage, stripping out script and style tags, and returns the first 5000 characters of the text content.

square_number.description: This tool calculates the square of a number provided as a string.

square_root.description: This tool calculates the square root of a given number.
